subject: Operational Readiness & Audit Package — Northway Bank questionnaire
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northwaybank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@northwaybank.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northway questionnaire — clarifications and evidence request

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the questionnaire response set you submitted earlier — Northway's audit team has a few follow-ups where we need clarifications or supporting artifacts before we can move this into our vendor approval queue. High-level asks:

- A short mapping (one page) that ties each Northway control question to the specific Redwood artifact (e.g., runbook, SOC2 section, logging retention policy).
- Evidence for DR and backup retention (pointers to runbooks or test summaries).
- A current snapshot of your SOC2/ISO attestations or an SOC2 summary PDF.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items by end-of-week (Fri, 16 May)? If you have an evidence matrix you can attach, that would help speed review.

Also please confirm the internal contact we can reach for a brief technical call (30 min) next week to review the DR runbook.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Northway Bank

[Attachment: Northway-Questionnaire-SectionB.pdf]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northwaybank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northway questionnaire — clarifications and evidence request

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can get you everything you asked for. Attached is an evidence matrix (spreadsheet) that maps each of your questionnaire items to Redwood artifacts and provides a pointer to the document or snapshot. Quick notes:

- Evidence matrix (attached): column mapping = Question ID / Redwood artifact / file reference / responsible SME / last updated.
- DR & backup: runbook excerpts and last DR test summary are included in the runbook PDF we will attach (see Marissa's follow-up).
- SOC2: we will include the SOC2 snapshot PDF (redacted where necessary) — Neha put that together.

Action items on our side:
- Marissa will attach the runbook summary + DR test notes.
- Neha will attach SOC2 summary PDF.
- I will schedule a 30-min technical call for next week and propose two slots (Tue/Wed).

Technical contact for the call: Karthik Iyer (Director, Platform Reliability) — karthik.iyer@redwood.com.

In the evidence matrix I flagged three items as "needs additional context" where we recommend a short call to walk through specifics (backup retention to object store vs. tenant cache, cross-region failover steps, and audit log retention by token level).

Let me know if you need a different format for the mapping.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: 20250511_infra-evidence_matrix.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northwaybank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northway questionnaire — clarifications and evidence request

Elena — attaching the two PDFs requested: a SOC2 snapshot (redacted) and a short DR/runbook summary that highlights recovery time objectives (RTOs), backup retention windows, and the cadence of failover exercises. Summary points below for quick review:

- Backup retention: primary backups retained 90 days on object storage; cold snapshot archives retained 3 years (encrypted, customer-key optional).
- DR tests: quarterly tabletop + annual full failover test; last full test: 2024-11-09 (summary included).
- Audit logging: token-level auditing retained for 365 days in hot storage, 7 years in cold encrypted archive (policy exceptions for regulated customers by contract).
- Change control: all runtime kernel, scheduler, and deployment changes go through JIRA pipeline + peer review; we include the ticket references in the XLS matrix.

Mapping excerpt (from the matrix):
- Q7 (BC/DR): runbook-DR-summary.pdf -> section 2.1 RTOs and section 3.2 DR test outputs.
- Q12 (audit logs): SOC2-snapshot-2024.pdf -> control A.3 logging & retention + internal logging policy doc reference.
- Q18 (data isolation): XLS -> architecture diagram + dedicated deployment templates reference.

If you want a short walkthrough, propose Tue 5/13 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 5/14 14:00–14:30 PT. Karthik will lead the technical walkthrough; I'll cover evidence mapping and compliance points.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2024.pdf, runbook-DR-summary.pdf]

From: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@northwaybank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@northwaybank.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northway questionnaire — clarifications and evidence request

Dylan/Marissa — received, thank you. The evidence matrix is exactly the format we needed and the two PDFs look good at a high level. A couple of quick follow-ups before we schedule a formal review:

1) Can you confirm the encryption-at-rest key management options you support (customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM vs. Redwood-managed)? If customer-managed, what KMS providers are supported?

2) For the backup retention statement: can you add in the matrix whether the 90-day primary backup retention is configurable per-customer (yes/no) and whether legal holds override deletion schedules?

We'll tentatively take Tue 5/13 10:00 PT for the walkthrough — please confirm. If possible, provide the KMS answer before the call so our legal team can review.

Thanks again — this moves us closer to vendor committee review.

Best regards,
Thomas Reed
Vendor Risk Manager
Northway Bank
